data.why: The repo ships 16 real RFID export CSVs in data/ (pens 1-4, lower/upper, two export timestamps each, ~308k raw reads); the GUI's folder-path field is pre-filled with that exact path, so the scientist can just click 'Load data' without uploading anything.

goals: load a colony's raw RFID exports and get a clean, de-duplicated per-read dataset with a QC report on dropped noise reads
pick one tagged mouse and see its circadian/locomotor activity (zone-transition rate, actogram, day-vs-night profile vs. the group mean)
quantify how that mouse uses space: occupancy and dwell time per zone, per pen, and per floor (upper/lower)
characterize movement: the zone-transition matrix and the pen-to-pen roaming network (bridge crossings, stair ascents/descents)
track time spent at the food antenna over the session to relate feeding behavior to activity
export a reproducible per-mouse figure bundle and summary CSV (with a manifest of the parameters used) for the record

review.summary: The tree follows the README's flow (load and clean, set mouse and parameters, examine activity, space, movement and feeding, then export), and every screen I opened shows what its node claims. Before filing it needs the upload path and the reproducible full-run export added as tasks, t2 split, the oversized and generic features recut, and a loader feature added.
